description: This file defines the Strategy class for configuring tree construction in Spark MLlib, including parameters like algorithm type, impurity measure, max depth, number of classes, and other hyperparameters. It also provides utility methods and default configurations.

classes.name: Strategy
classes.description: Configuration class for decision tree parameters in Spark MLlib, supporting classification and regression settings, with validation and utility methods.

methods.name: isMulticlassClassification
methods.description: Checks if the strategy is for multiclass classification.

methods.name: isMulticlassWithCategoricalFeatures
methods.description: Checks if the strategy is for multiclass classification with categorical features.

methods.name: setAlgo
methods.description: Sets the algorithm type based on a string input.

methods.name: setCategoricalFeaturesInfo
methods.description: Sets categorical features information from a Java Map.

methods.name: assertValid
methods.description: Validates the strategy parameters, throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the Strategy instance.
